# projects.html

A project is an item that has a deliverable that you would like to showcase (i.e. a paper, code, a repository, a presentation, a model, a video, data visualizations).

Right now the template project section has a card for:

- **A class project** - a project from class (it can be DataTrail or from school),
- **Your blog**, and
- **Your DataTrail capstone project:**

Write in your notes the name or title for at least one project that could be classified as each of these
Draft a short description
And compile any links to your project's deliverables. If you don't want to link to an external Drive or DropBox for example, you'll want to download these and upload them to the docs folder in your portfolio's repository. There can be some benefits to using these online storage platforms, as for many of them you can readily see traffic link clicks are getting.

Right now, there are boilerplate photos in this section. In a later assignment, you'll use your favorite plot as the capstone project photo.

Other links will be styled here later in the course: your slide deck link (@sec-slide-deck), and DataTrail Python notebook results (@sec-finishing-touches). If your capstone leads to a publication or presentation, you can link to that here too.
